prospect_summary: Kompas Praha DMC is the inbound destination-management arm of the Kompas International Travel Group, a 70+ year European travel network active in 12 countries. Operating from Prague, they handle incoming travel services across the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Austria, Poland, Hungary, and the broader Balkans. Their primary focus is MICE - corporate meetings, conferences, incentive programs, team building, and gala events - delivered end-to-end for international event agencies, incentive houses, and corporate meeting planners. They also provide ground-handling, FIT, and leisure group programs for foreign tour operators and travel agencies, including hotel blocks, transfers, guides, and custom multi-day itinerary design. The wider Kompas group's primary markets include Germany, Italy, Spain, Portugal, Scandinavia, and other European source countries.
